items.title: In graphic detail: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem
items.excerpt: Digiday charts ChatGPT Ads' growth to roughly 6,000 brands against thin conversion proof; OpenAI's path to a $100B ad business hinges on advertiser demand, measurement and monetisation.

items.title: Digiday Media Buying Summit October Recap: Assessing the ups and challenges of AI's spread across the media agency landscape
items.excerpt: AI has swept across media agencies, from planning and measurement tools that mine audience data to creative work, while clients also demand guidance on putting AI to use. (Weaker, recap-style.)

items.title: Swivel Wants To Create Agentic Infrastructure For CTV
items.excerpt: Publisher-tech startup Swivel, founded by ex-FreeWheel and SpringServe executives, is building infrastructure so AI agents can buy TV and streaming ads, automating manual direct-deal tasks in CTV.

items.title: 60% of UK adults would drop an AI shopping agent after one mistake, ACI finds
items.excerpt: A YouGov poll of 2,080 UK adults for ACI found only 19% trust AI to make everyday purchases versus 55% for a human adviser, and 60% would abandon an AI shopping agent after one error.

items.title: Amazon opens its search to outside stores as bots block AI shoppers
items.excerpt: Amazon launched the Shop Direct Merchant Workspace so eligible non-Amazon retailers can list in its search for free; shoppers click through or let Amazon's Buy for Me AI complete the purchase. (Blend audit part already covered.)

items.title: ChatGPT reaches a fifth of Google search volume as Taboola blames AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI said ChatGPT's search-like query volume is about one-fifth of Google's, while Taboola blamed AI summaries for a 6.9% revenue drop, signalling where search ad budgets may move. (Weaker; roundup.)

items.title: 네이버, 광고주센터 '네이버애즈'로 개편…AI가 광고 성과 분석·개선 제안
items.excerpt: 네이버가 광고주센터를 AI 기반 광고 플랫폼 '네이버애즈(N Ads)'로 개편했다. AI 광고 에이전트가 캠페인 성과를 진단하고 개선안을 먼저 제안하며 광고 미노출 원인도 찾아준다.

items.title: 카카오 "내달 광고 AI 에이전트 'AI 크루' 베타 시작"
items.excerpt: 카카오가 3분기 실적 발표에서 목표만 입력하면 광고 집행과 성과 분석을 돕는 광고 AI 에이전트 'AI 크루'를 12월 베타로 시작한다고 밝혔다. 내년 1분기까지 AI 광고 추천용 공통 메모리 인프라도 구축한다.

items.title: 몰로코, AI 광고 최적화 기술로 콘텐츠·서비스 발견 앞당긴다
items.excerpt: 몰로코가 AI 광고 최적화 엔진을 앱 광고에서 독립 앱·CTV·쇼핑몰로 넓히고, AI 에이전트 쇼핑 시대에도 광고로 상품·서비스 발견을 돕겠다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 에이전틱 커머스 확산...유통·결제사, 브랜드 노출 전략 바꾼다
items.excerpt: AI가 상품 검색·비교·추천을 대신하는 에이전틱 커머스가 확산하면서 아멕스·구글·월마트 등 유통·결제업계가 AI 추천에 상품을 노출하고 결제를 연결하는 방식으로 고객 확보 전략을 바꾸고 있다.

items.title: Bring Your Holiday Campaigns to Life with Google AI | Creative Drop #2
items.excerpt: Google Ads' Creative Drop #2 adds AI tools to localize campaigns, generate festive product shots in Asset Studio and turn photos into YouTube video ads for the holiday season. (Off-list google first-party domain.)

items.title: Top 5 Learnings from Vercel's COO: 10 SDRs Down to 1, a $5K-a-Year Lead Agent, and 93% of Support Cases Handled by AI
items.excerpt: Vercel went from 10 people qualifying inbound leads to one six weeks after turning on an AI lead agent costing under $5,000 a year, with SDR quotas up 30%. (Off-list; no on-list AI SDR story.)

items.title: Visa launches benchmark for AI shopping agents
items.excerpt: Visa's new Agentic Commerce Benchmark found leading AI models passed 57.2% of realistic shopping tests, and 54% of failed runs still ended in a purchase. (Off-list; agentic checkout.)

items.title: A growing streetwear retailer reveals its AI agent shopping strategy ahead of the holidays
items.excerpt: All Star Elite, a 60-store US streetwear chain, is optimizing its online catalog and pricing for AI shopping bots ahead of the holidays. (Off-list; page gives date only.)

items.title: Just Eat Takeaway.com launches JETads, a new AI-first advertising platform for European advertisers
items.excerpt: JET launched JETads, an AI-first retail media platform live in 14 markets, using its personalisation models across 59M consumers and 592M yearly orders, with closed-loop measurement for restaurants, FMCG and non-endemic brands. (Off-list first-party.)

items.title: Ads in Chatbots Have Arrived. Here's What's Working—and What's Not
items.excerpt: With OpenAI past 100,000 ChatGPT advertisers and Google expanding AI Mode ads, WIRED looks at what is working in chatbot ad formats, including niche-chatbot ad tech such as Koah Labs, while Anthropic keeps Claude ad-free. (Off-list.)

items.title: HS Ad links AI agent to forecast Netflix ad reach and unify media planning
items.excerpt: Korean agency HS Ad connected an AI agent to its media planning system so planners can ask in natural language for expected Netflix ad reach by target and budget and compare scenarios. (Off-list.)

items.title: Google allows Gmail and Photos data for personalised ads in Search, Gemini
items.excerpt: Google's updated privacy policy lets Search and Gemini use content from connected Gmail, Drive, Calendar and Photos to personalise ads, e.g. calendar events connected to Gemini. (Off-list; policy effective Oct 16, reported Nov 5.)
